info.title: Better Proposals Universal API
info.description: Create, send, track, and sign Better Proposals proposals and quotes from MindCloud using the official Better Proposals API.

post.description: Creates a proposal in Better Proposals.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

company.description: Either a company ID or company name. When a name is provided, Better Proposals creates the company if needed.

template.description: Template ID. When provided, Better Proposals copies the template into the new proposal.

documentType.description: Document type ID or name. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the default proposal document type.

brand.description: Brand ID. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the default brand.

currency.description: Currency code in 3-letter format, for example USD.

tax.description: Whether to apply tax. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the default brand setting.

taxLabel.description: Tax label. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the default brand setting.

taxAmount.description: Tax amount. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the default brand setting.

contacts[].description: Array of contact objects with FirstName, Surname, Email, and Signature fields.

mergeTags[].description: Array of custom merge-tag objects with tag and value fields.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

brandId.description: Brand ID. If omitted, Better Proposals uses the brand settings defaults.

headline.description: Cover headline. Default is Proposal for _________.

subheader.description: Cover subheader. Default is Written by ________ for ________.

textColour.description: Text colour value. Default is ffffff.

buttonText.description: Button text. Default is Start Reading Proposal.
